Group home screen apps into folders, like stock Android. Foldables show two home pages side by side on the inner screen. Linux apps and Android now share the clipboard, and terminal selections are highlighted in the theme's accent and copied when you let go. Linux installs right away when you tick it on the welcome screen. Widgets can shrink further, apps pinned to a full page move to the next page with room, and dragging tiles around home is smoother.
